title: Cliff Palace Ruins, Mesa Verde Colorado - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
location: Mesa Verde National Park, Colorado, USA
description: A striking black-and-white tourist snapshot capturing the ancient multi-story sandstone masonry of Cliff Palace sheltered beneath the massive sandstone alcove at Mesa Verde National Park in southwestern Colorado. Constructed by the Ancestral Puebloans during the 12th and 13th centuries, the site became a focal point of American heritage and early automotive travel in the early-to-mid 20th century as travelers journeyed west to visit famous national parks and archaeological monuments.
